kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: AI chatbots are becoming political advisers. Their answers can mislead voters
wire.summary: Millions of Americans are turning to AI for election information, but chatbots are getting voting facts wrong and recommending candidates, raising concerns they could influence voters' decisions.

wire.title: Is America really that polarized? The answer might be a surprise
wire.summary: The U.S. has become more politically polarized, but research shows people overestimate their differences and there is 'messy middle' majority of Americans who share overlapping political views.

wire.title: Judge accuses DOJ of 'weaponization,' tosses case against ex-FBI officials
wire.summary: The judge said he was "deeply troubled" by the mistakes and rushed nature of the case over the FBI's Hunter Biden probes — one of several politically charged DOJ actions ahead of the midterms.

wire.title: DOJ asks for Supreme Court to intervene on California ballot demands
wire.summary: On the eve of the Nov. 3 election, the Trump administration is hoping the Supreme Court will reverse lower courts that rejected its request to order California to set aside the ballots of thousands of people it says are "likely" noncitizens.

wire.title: Haley Stevens backs Mike Rogers. And, Gulf states brace for potential attack on Iran
wire.summary: Democrats in Michigan are considering their options after Haley Stevens endorsed GOP candidate Mike Rogers for Senate. And the Gulf states are bracing for a possible U.S. attack on Iran after the midterms.

wire.title: Two economists studied California's billionaire tax. They reached wildly different conclusions
wire.summary: What happens in California could shape how America taxes the superrich. But will its billionaire tax fill state coffers — or drain them?

wire.title: When it comes to election pressure, this year's Georgia or Michigan could be anywhere
wire.summary: The districts that will decide control of the House and Senate next year are spread across the country. Voting officials in those places may face scrutiny and pressure they've never experienced.

wire.title: How does this fluoride-free toothpaste compare when it comes to oral health?
wire.summary: Many people are swapping out their fluoride dental products for ones made with a mineral called hydroxyapatite. What do dentists say about it?

wire.title: 6 things to watch for on election night
wire.summary: Some of the key storylines to watch will center around various voters groups that have soured on President Trump during his second turn out.

wire.title: With students scarce, college admissions offices get friendlier, less intimidating
wire.summary: Colleges are trying to transform an admissions process that has often been daunting, secretive and stressful into an experience that's open, easier — and downright friendly.

wire.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
wire.summary: Officials say at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a southern Ukrainian village in what the president called an "utterly horrific" attack.

wire.title: Copilot in deadly Florida jet crash identified in reports as 20-year-old
wire.summary: In air traffic audio, a crew member can be heard shouting: "We are going to crash into the ground!"

wire.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
wire.summary: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

wire.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
wire.summary: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.

wire.title: Legal challenge to Australia's social media ban to start in High Court
wire.summary: A rights group will argue the world-leading policy robs under-16s of their right to free communication.

wire.title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president
wire.summary: The case, part of the "Farmgate" scandal, has left President Cyril Ramaphosa mired in an impeachment saga.
